description:
Update an existing product in the StarShipIt product catalogue by its numeric ID.

Use this to correct product details, update dimensions/weights, add customs codes, or change any other product attribute. The product `id` must be provided both at the top level and inside the `product` object — this is a StarShipIt API requirement.

**Required top-level fields:**
- `id`: Numeric product ID (obtain via `starshipit_list_products`)

**Required `product` object fields:**
- `id`: Same numeric product ID (must match top-level id)
- `sku`: Product SKU (can be the existing SKU unchanged)
- `title`: Product title (can be the existing title unchanged)

**Optional `product` object fields:** All standard product fields (customs_description, country, weight, height, length, width, hs_code, color, size, barcode, bin_location, brand, usage, material, model, mid, price, dangerous_goods, description).

**Returns:** The updated product object.

**Error cases:**
- 400: Validation errors (e.g. invalid field values)
- 404: Product with given ID not found
- 409: SKU conflict with another product

**Use this tool when:**
- Correcting product weight or dimensions after a measurement error
- Adding missing HS codes to products before an international shipment
- Updating a product price or customs description

id.description: Numeric product ID to update (obtain via starshipit_list_products)

product.description: Full product object including id, sku, title, and any fields to update

country.description: Country of origin — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name (e.g. "AU", "Australia")

dangerous_goods.description: Whether the product is classified as dangerous goods (DG)

description.description: Internal product description (not used for customs)

hs_code.description: Harmonised System (HS) tariff code for customs (e.g. "6109.10")

id.description: Numeric product ID — must match the top-level id field (StarShipIt API requirement)

material.description: Primary material the product is made from

mid.description: Manufacturer Identification (MID) code for US customs

price.description: Product price (used for declared customs value)

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit — unique product identifier (required)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for machine-readable

name: starshipit_update_product

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Update Product
